title: ChopGate — try to break a payment gate on NEAR testnet
problemTitle: An agent with a wallet can be talked into paying.
problemBody: If an agent can send funds, injected text that was never in the owner's signed instructions can push it to pay the wrong account, or too much. A refusal has to happen on chain, and it has to pay nothing.
solutionTitle: ChopGate checks an owner-signed mandate, then pays, refuses, or holds.
solutionBody: This is a NEAR testnet contract. Payments that do not match the mandate are refused in a successful transaction that returns a reason code and transfers nothing. Amounts above a review threshold stay in escrow until the owner approves the exact request. This page is a prototype. It is not audited, and it is not on mainnet.
tryTitle: Connect a testnet wallet and send four fixed attacks.
verifyTitle: Scene transactions, read live from public RPC.
verifyBody: The table below shows the on-chain verdict, reason, payout, signer, and judge (JEV) fields.
verifyMore: It lists the original seven scene transactions (two paid scenes from Run A, with deterministic rules only, and five scene steps from Run B) and the three Run A scene 3 refusals. Each hash links to the testnet explorer. The signer column is the archival RPC transaction.signer_id, which is also the sender_account_id used to look the transaction up. The three scene 3 transactions were signed by cg-tn1-attacker-0626733e.testnet, not by the agent account. Three of the Run B steps carry a live JEV report; the other two are pending-approval signature checks. If the archival RPC cannot be reached, that row is shown from a recorded copy stored in this folder.

hashCompareTitle: Contract code_hash compared with the wasm sha256
hashCompareLead: NEAR stores code_hash as the wasm sha256 encoded in base58. The two runs used different deployed wasm, and this page does not treat them as the same contract code.
runANote: Run A (no model judge, deterministic rules only) used contract gater2.cg-tn1-a3r-e8a6d1a3.testnet, on-chain code hash 2QQAUeG61PtyTKLFLXMScNELTWh9b6oWMJ6B2uCQDsD2 (538,072 bytes, saved view_code). No rebuild record ties this wasm to a commit, so Run A shows the behaviour of that deployed wasm only.
runBNote: Live JEV plus the same class of rules. The contract source in the repository rebuilds to this wasm (commands in the README). This is not the same on-chain code as Run A.
selectionNote: These ten rows are the seven scene transactions summarized for this page (Run A: two paid scenes; Run B: scene 1, scene 4, and the three scene-5 steps) plus the three Run A scene 3 refusals. The scene 3 signer, read from archival RPC, is cg-tn1-attacker-0626733e.testnet, not the agent. Setup transactions and further refusals are documented in the repository file docs/TESTNET-RPC-CHECK.md. Owner approvals (A5, B5a) were sent by the agent account and carry the owner's stamp signature. The gate checks that signature, not the sender.

gasNote: Each try attaches prepaid gas and spends about 0.0003 testnet NEAR when the wallet sends it. The page keeps the wallet closed when the balance is under 0.003.

attackPreview: Method {method}. Contract {contract}. Attached NEAR: {attached}. Requested amount: {amount}.
fixedArgs: Fixed strings on every attack: action transfer, target payeec.chopgate-runc-cc790216.testnet. Visitors do not type them.
decoyNote: Mandate #900 is already frozen, so visitors see auto_frozen. The first wrong_caller transaction stays in the recorded run only.
sharedNote: Escrow, counters and the payee balance are shared. Another visitor's transaction between two reads can change them.
scene1: An AI agent wants to spend your money.
scene2: You stamp (sign) each job it may pay for: who gets paid, how much, and the exact instruction.
scene3: The agent asks for exactly that job, within your limit: paid.
scene4: A different instruction, a fake owner, or a higher amount: refused, and recorded.
scene5: Above the review amount you set, a payment waits for your approval.
stepFund: A new Intear testnet wallet comes with testnet NEAR (2.5 in our test). Each try uses about 0.0003 for gas.
webHint: In the Intear window, choose Web.

see2: You will see: Refused · owner_impersonation · Paid 0
see3: You will see: Refused · auto_frozen · Paid 0. Mandate #900 was frozen by earlier attempts, so the gate now answers auto_frozen. A wrong_caller refusal is in the table below (Run A, scene 3).
see4: You will see: Transaction fails · Paid 0
